culprit_citations.quoted_text: Investments-non-controlled/non-affiliated (1) (2) | Footnotes | Investment | Reference Rate and Spread | Interest Rate (3) | Maturity Date | Par Amount/ Shares (4) | Cost (5) | Fair Value | Percentage of Net Assets

(4) | Par amount is presented for debt investments, while the number of shares or units owned is presented for equity investments. Par amount is denominated in U.S. Dollars ("$" or "USD") unless otherwise noted, Euro ("EUR"), Great British Pound ("GBP"), or Canadian dollar ("CAD").

findings.detail: The CAD marker belongs to Par Amount/Shares, not Cost; cost should remain USD-denominated.

rationale: FX03 is a Class 1 single-cell unit check. The flagged value is cost_currency=CAD. The raw schedule header separates Par Amount/Shares (4), Cost (5), and Fair Value, and footnote 4 limits CAD/EUR/GBP notation to par amount or shares. The cited row shows C$ immediately before the par amount, followed by separate cost and fair value values. Therefore CAD was propagated from the par amount column into the cost currency field, making the flag a real data error.
